site_name: Edged Chicago (ORD01) campus, 2835 Bilter Rd, Aurora IL 60502
year_evidence_quote: A new data centre operated by Edged has opened in Aurora, Illinois
year_site_match: The same article places the campus by street address: "Sitting at 2835 Bilter Road, the newly launched Edged Chicago campus". That matches 2835 Bilter Rd, Aurora. It describes this as the first of three planned buildings.
verification: Claimed year 2025 confirmed. DataCenterNews (27 Feb 2025) says the facility has opened and that a ribbon cutting marked its debut. A second DataCenterNews piece dated 9 Jun 2026 corroborates: "Edged opened its first facility on the Aurora campus in February 2025." and gives 2835 Bilter Road for the campus. ConnectCRE (25 Feb 2025) gives the same address but only describes the ribbon cutting as planned, so it is not the deciding page.

lead.year_evidence_quote: A new data centre operated by Edged has opened in Aurora, Illinois

phases.label: Building 1 (about 24 MW of a 96 MW campus)

lead.notes: DataCenterNews US, dated 27 Feb 2025, says the Edged data centre has opened and places it at 2835 Bilter Road, which matches the permit address. A ConnectCRE piece dated 25 Feb 2025 gives the same address but only says a ribbon cutting is planned. A second building on the campus topped out in 2026 per search snippets. I did not open that page, so it is not listed as a phase.

site_name: Equinix CH3, 1905 Lunt Ave, Elk Grove Village IL 60007
year_evidence_quote: Equinix (EQIX) held a grand opening today for the $175 million first phase of its new Chicago data center
year_site_match: The article names the facility: the new Chicago Internet Business Exchange "known as CH3", in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. The article has no street address. The CH3-to-address tie comes from PeeringDB's public facility record (operator-maintained registry, opened via its API): name "Equinix CH3 - Elk Grove", address1 "1905 Lunt Ave", Elk Grove Village IL 60007, org Equinix, Inc.
verification: Claimed year 2007 confirmed for the named facility CH3. Caveat to weigh: the opening article itself does not carry the street address; the link between the name CH3 and 1905 Lunt Ave rests on PeeringDB, which is a registry rather than a primary source (it is not on the excluded directory list, but treat the address tie as registry-grade, not operator-page-grade). Equinix's own CH3 page and the 2009 Equinix press release both returned HTTP 403 and were not read. Byline date is 24 Oct 2007; "today" in the quote refers to that date.

lead.year_evidence_quote: Equinix (EQIX) held a grand opening today for the $175 million first phase of its new Chicago Internet Business Exchange
lead.notes: A Data Center Knowledge article dated 24 Oct 2007 reports the grand opening of the first phase of CH3 in Elk Grove Village. Only directory listings tie the name CH3 to 1905 Lunt Ave (they suggested the name; they are not cited as evidence). Equinix's own CH3 page refused automated access, so I could not confirm the address there. Other Equinix Elk Grove buildings, such as CH5, are newer and at different addresses.

site_name: Meta DeKalb Data Center, Gurler Rd, DeKalb IL 60115
year_evidence_quote: Meta's new data center in DeKalb is officially operational
year_site_match: Named facility and city only: Meta's data center in DeKalb, Ill. (dateline DEKALB, Ill.; one million square feet built of 2.3 million planned). The page gives no street or road. Tie to Gurler Rd rests on Meta having a single DeKalb campus, which is my inference from general knowledge and was not confirmed on any page opened.
verification: Claimed year 2023 confirmed. Fox 32 (published 29 Nov 2023, headline "Meta's new Illinois data center now operational") and a Center Square item reprinted in Lincoln Daily News on 30 Nov 2023 ("Meta ... announced that its new Illinois data center is up and running.") agree. Neither page states Gurler Rd or the Goldframe LLC entity. Meta's own DeKalb page returned an image rather than text, a DCD URL returned 403, and The Center Square original redirected to a bot-toll host, so none of those were read. I am uncertain whether any hall on the campus carried load before the November 2023 announcement; the pages do not say.

lead.year_evidence_quote: Meta's new data center in DeKalb is officially operational, marking a significant milestone
lead.notes: Fox 32 Chicago, dated 29 Nov 2023, says Meta's DeKalb data center is officially operational. The article gives no street address. I tied it to this site because DeKalb has only one Meta campus, and Goldframe LLC on the permit is assumed to be Meta's site entity, which I did not verify. I did not check the dates of later buildings on the campus.

site_name: Serverfarm CH1 (former Server Farm Realty), 840 S Canal St, Chicago IL 60607
year_evidence_quote: Data center developer Server Farm Realty (SFR) this week opened its new Chicago facility at 840 South Canal Street
year_site_match: Street address in the opening sentence, 840 South Canal Street, Chicago, matches the claim address exactly. Operator Server Farm Realty is the predecessor name of Serverfarm.
verification: The page supports 2013 outright as the opening of the Server Farm Realty facility (byline 13 Jun 2013; anchor tenant Peerless Network already occupying the top floor). I lowered confidence from the researcher's high to medium for one reason: the same article says the building "previously housed a General Electric factory and served as Northern Trust's data center and operations hub", with no dates. So a data center load existed at this address before 2013. 2013 dates the current multi-tenant facility after SFR's redevelopment (site acquired early 2011, more than $220 million invested per the article), not the first data center use of the address. If the study needs first-ever data center operation at the parcel, this year is not it and the earlier date is unsourced. The Mission Critical page returned no readable text.

lead.year_evidence_quote: this week opened its new Chicago facility at 840 South Canal Street
lead.notes: Data Center Knowledge, dated 13 Jun 2013, says Server Farm Realty opened its facility at 840 South Canal Street, which matches the permit address. Search snippets say the building was earlier Northern Trust's data center and operations hub. That earlier use could predate 2013, but I did not verify it. The year here is the Server Farm Realty opening.

site_name: Stream Data Centers Chicago II (ORDB), 1925 Busse Rd, Elk Grove Village IL 60007
verification: The site match is solid but the page does not state an operating date. It says phase one commissioning was initiated in 3Q22, which is the start of testing, not completion, delivery, or tenant occupancy. The only other dated statement is "In 2023, the site was fully leased by a few select cloud providers and hyperscale tenants." The start is therefore 2022 or 2023 and the page does not settle which; 2022 is the more likely reading (inference, not verified). The page is undated (footer copyright 2026 only). The Dec 2020 release is forward-looking (construction to begin Feb 2021, early occupancy 3Q 2021). I scanned Stream's news index pages 1 to 5 (2019 through 2026 headlines) and found no Chicago II commissioning or delivery release. Good lead for a later pass: EPA ENERGY STAR registry or a trade-press delivery notice.

lead.year_evidence_quote: Stream acquired the site, and launched development in 2020, and initiated phase one commissioning in 3Q22.
lead.notes: Stream's Chicago locations page names Chicago II at 1925 Busse Road. It says phase one commissioning began in 3Q22 and the site was fully leased in 2023. Confidence is medium because the start of commissioning is not an explicit operating date. Stream's Dec 2020 release, which projected early occupancy in 3Q 2021, is forward-looking only.

site_name: Digital Realty 105 Cabot Street (BOS16), Needham MA 02494
year_evidence_quote: Digital Realty will host the grand opening of 105 Cabot Street on Wednesday, June 5, 2013.
year_site_match: The release headline and body name the building by address: "Data Center at 105 Cabot Street in Needham, Massachusetts"; event location given as "Digital Realty, 105 Cabot Street, Needham, MA". This is the 105 Cabot building, not the older 128 First Avenue building.
verification: Claimed year 2013 supported at medium, not high. The operator release is dated 3 Jun 2013 and headlined "Digital Realty Announces Grand Opening of World-Class Data Center at 105 Cabot Street"; the event sentence is future tense by two days, which is why this is not high. Present-tense support in the same release: a Digital Realty executive is quoted, "We have already begun leasing space at 105 Cabot, and are very pleased to bring this facility online". Consistent with the 2012 groundbreaking pages (Patch 21 Mar 2012, NEREJ 19 Apr 2012), which quote the leasing agent expecting "delivery in Q2 2013" (forward-looking, not evidence by itself). I found no post-event report confirming the 5 Jun 2013 opening took place or a first tenant go-live date. The Digital Realty URL I tried resolved to a Boston listing showing only 128 First Avenue and carried no opening date; a NEREJ site search surfaced nothing relevant on its first page.

lead.year_evidence_quote: Digital Realty will host the grand opening of 105 Cabot Street on Wednesday, June 5, 2013.
lead.notes: A Digital Realty release dated 3 Jun 2013 announces the grand opening of the 105 Cabot Street building on 5 Jun 2013, and an executive quoted in it speaks of bringing the facility online. Construction began in 2012. Confidence is medium because the release came before the event and I found no report confirming it happened. 128 First Avenue is a separate, older sibling building on the Needham campus and is not dated here.
